purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century histology collections recovered through deep multilingual search.
guards: Keep laboratory preparation date separate from later remounting annotation museum acquisition or legal bequest.
Where a named collection spans 1900 isolate pre-1900 slides through labels methods publications or item dates before counting.
Do not merge wooden glass cardboard or other support formats into a single undifferentiated slide-material field.

adapters.institution_scope: University Museum System Pavia Golgi collections
adapters.target: official Golgi Room plus peer-reviewed 38-slide study
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract each surviving slide tissue support label signature/date and later annotation; retain official museum custody separately from laboratory preparation.

adapters.target: official legal legacy documentation plus scholarly histological-slide catalogue studies
adapters.promotion_rule: Use label styles city periods staining method and publication links to isolate pre-1900 slides; retain 1931 bequest and current inventory totals as later layers.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Florence Museo Anatomico Fiorentino
adapters.target: official museum account of Pacini catalogued histological preparations
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture date reagent observation and remounting statements from labels; preserve the 1854 preparation and seven-years-later remounting as separate events.

adapters.institution_scope: Sorbonne Universite medical collections / Fondation Dejerine
adapters.target: official collection brochure and SorbonNum+ item portal
adapters.promotion_rule: Traverse item records and publication/case links; isolate 1895-1899 neurological slides rather than treating the full twentieth-century-extended foundation as nineteenth-century.

adapters.target: official collection history plus portal discovery for dated histological slides
adapters.promotion_rule: Use the collection page only as a nineteenth-century existence node; promote item counts only after portal-level date and material confirmation.
